name: Neues
source: One day a forest inspector found in the forest a droid girl, without knowing who created it or why it was left there he decided to bring her to his house. The girl droid got his own feelings and ideas but what is more important she wants to become human not only by her feelings but of fact.
translation: 一天，一名森林巡护员在森林里发现了一个机器人女孩。他不知道是谁创造了她，也不知道她为何被遗弃，便决定把她带回家。机器人女孩有了自己的情感和想法；更重要的是，她不仅在感情上想成为人类，也希望自己真的变成人。
